_meta.description: RecurringInvoiceProfile learns the CustomerMaster it bills (customerMasterId, design D2) and records why it ended (cancellation, design D1). Every generated invoice copies customerMasterId into customerId; the LinkRecurringProfilesToCustomers repair step fills it on existing profiles. Both end transitions ask for a reason code: CancellationReasonGuard refuses a staff end without one, RecordCancellationAction writes the cancellation record. Version bumped past recurring-invoicing (0.1.0) so the import writes the change.

customerMasterId.title: Customer record
customerMasterId.description: The financial customer this profile bills, resolved from its contact. Copied into each generated invoice.

cancellationReasonCode.title: Cancellation reason
cancellationReasonCode.description: Why the subscription ends, asked on End. Staff choose a reason other than not-given; a customer may leave it out.

cancellationReasonText.title: Cancellation note
cancellationReasonText.description: Optional free text with the cancellation reason.

cancellation.title: Cancellation
cancellation.description: Who ended the subscription, why, when it was requested and when it takes effect. Written when the profile ends.

cancellationQuarter.title: Cancellation quarter
cancellationQuarter.description: The quarter the cancellation takes effect, as YYYY-Qn. Written with the cancellation, for the cancellation reasons report.

cancellationMonthlyAmount.title: Lost monthly amount
cancellationMonthlyAmount.description: What the profile billed per month before VAT when it ended. Written with the cancellation, for the cancellation reasons report.

actions.description: Write the cancellation record: reason, note, who ended it, when it was asked and when it takes effect (RecordCancellationAction).

cancellationReasons.description: Ended subscriptions per quarter of the effective date and per reason code: how many, and the monthly recurring amount lost (REQ-SCX-002).

withdrawalExempt.title: Exempt from withdrawal
withdrawalExempt.description: A consumer who books this service online cannot withdraw, for example a leisure service on a specific date. Counts only with a named exemption reason.

withdrawalExemptionReason.title: Exemption reason
withdrawalExemptionReason.description: Why this service is exempt from the right of withdrawal, shown to the consumer, for example: leisure service on a specific date.

depositPaymentId.title: Deposit payment
depositPaymentId.description: The DepositPayment taken for this booking, refunded in full on a withdrawal.

withdrawal.title: Withdrawal
withdrawal.description: Set when the consumer withdrew from the booking.

Withdrawal.title: Withdrawal
Withdrawal.description: A consumer's withdrawal from a booking made online (Directive 2011/83/EU article 11a): cancelled without a fee, every payment refunded, acknowledged by e-mail.

requestedAt.title: Withdrawn at
requestedAt.description: The moment the consumer confirmed the withdrawal.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Where the consumer withdrew: the portal, or the signed link from the confirmation.

acknowledgedAt.title: Acknowledged at
acknowledgedAt.description: When the acknowledgement e-mail was sent.

refundAmount.title: Refund (cents)
refundAmount.description: Everything paid for the booking, refunded in full, in cents.

refundStatus.title: Refund status
refundStatus.description: none: nothing was paid; initiated: the payment adapter started the refund; due: staff must pay it by refundDueBy; failed: the adapter refused, staff must pay it.

refundDueBy.title: Refund due by
refundDueBy.description: The latest day the refund must be paid: 14 days after the withdrawal (article 13).

invoiceId.title: Invoice to credit
invoiceId.description: The deposit's invoice, credited in full for the withdrawal.

onWithdrawal.description: Tell the booking operators a consumer withdrew, and whether a refund is due by hand.
